name: Yanfei
notes: Both sources: Normal Attack > Burst > Skill, an ATK% Sands (KQM: EM or ATK%), a Pyro DMG Goblet, a CRIT Circlet, 4pc Crimson Witch of Flames first for Vaporize and Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds first. Other sets: Game8's Charged Attack build uses Shimenawa's Reminiscence; KQM adds Marechaussee Hunter (best with Furina), Wanderer's Troupe, Gilded Dreams and Lavawalker. Both also give a C4 shield support (ER Sands, HP% Goblet and Circlet, 4pc Noblesse Oblige, Prototype Amber first) and KQM an EM reaction build (Gilded Dreams); those are not the main plan and are left out of the lists, except Gilded Dreams. Her damage is her Charged Attack, a Normal Attack talent whose 1-hit line is on the elemental curve (58.3% to 105.0%, ratio 1.80). Neither source gives CRIT or ATK goals. ER is KQM's 120-130 for a Burst every other rotation (upper end); her Burst needs more than 250 ER if cast every rotation. Partners are inferred (Hydro for Vaporize, Pyro, Dendro for Burgeon); the sources give no team list.
